children.value: Offing has no telemetry and never will: a scan does not phone home, and nothing about how people use it is collected. Adoption is measured only from public data that anyone can look up, with one exception: the Search Console landing pages, which only the verified site owner can see and the maintainer enters by hand. Every other number can be reproduced, and none of it comes from users.

A repository that keeps Offing in CI for a month is a real user. Adding an Action once may be an experiment or a brief evaluation; continuing to run it across two consecutive calendar months reflects sustained adoption.

metric compares the repositories observed in the current month against the union of all repositories observed in snapshots from the immediately preceding calendar month (
). Any repository present in both months counts as a repeat user.
: GitHub code search indexes repositories asynchronously and returns at most 1,000 files per query. Repositories in private code, unindexed forks, or past the 1,000-result threshold are omitted.
: Snapshots capture point-in-time state. A repository that introduces and removes the Action between snapshots is not captured.

: A repository adopting the Action near the end of one month and keeping it for a few days into the next counts as two consecutive months despite brief duration; conversely, an installation spanning 30 days entirely within one calendar month requires a subsequent month's snapshot to register as repeat use.
: A repository renamed between months is treated as a departure and a new arrival rather than repeat use.
: Public code search observes workflow configuration files, not private workflow run histories or execution success.
